caption: The image depicts an old-fashioned cast iron wood-burning stove set against a plain, off-white background. The stove is rectangular and stands on four ornate, curved legs. It is colored in dark shades of brown and black, showing metallic surfaces with some lighter highlights indicating edges and surfaces that catch the light. The stove has multiple doors and panels with decorative patterns on its sides and front. The top surface features several circular plates and a flat handle protruding from one of the covers, along with a tall cylindrical chimney or flue pipe attached to the back-right corner, extending vertically upward. The stove has a protruding front shelf or warming area on its left side. There are visible hinges, latches, and raised detailing across the body of the stove, emphasizing its three-dimensional and robust construction. The overall look is industrial and utilitarian, typical of vintage stoves.
title: Stove (Model)
